steps.en: Install Services and Companion on a system with signature support
steps.zh: 在支持签名伪装的系统安装服务与配套组件

steps.en: Enable registration and cloud messaging; allow background operation
steps.zh: 启用设备注册与云消息，允许后台运行

steps.en: Registers the device and maintains its Google messaging connection
steps.zh: 注册设备并维持 Google 消息连接

steps.en: Run the existing app's push-registration flow
steps.zh: 运行现有应用的推送注册流程

steps.en: Receives cloud messages and delivers them to the target app
steps.zh: 接收云消息并转交目标应用

value.en: Compatible apps receive Google-backed push without Google's proprietary Play services app
value.zh: 兼容应用无需官方闭源服务程序，也能接收 Google 推送
